form.label: IDS Overview
form.description: Network visibility and threat detection from the IDS sensor L4H1_IDS (SPAN aggregator): Suricata alerts (index suricata) and Zeek network logs (index zeek), grouped by lab zone (lookup lab_zones). Click any IP to focus on it; set the IP box back to * to clear. Managed from MC01 tools\splunk-uf\ds\apps\lab_security.

search.query: index=suricata event_type=alert alert.severity<=2 (src_ip=$ip$ OR dest_ip=$ip$) | stats count
index=zeek sourcetype="bro:conn:json" (id.orig_h=$ip$ OR id.resp_h=$ip$) | stats dc(id.orig_h) as hosts
index=zeek sourcetype="bro:conn:json" (id.orig_h=$ip$ OR id.resp_h=$ip$) | `ids_zeek_zones` | where src_zone!=dest_zone AND NOT dest_zone IN ("Multicast", "Broadcast", "Link-local") | stats count
index=zeek sourcetype="bro:conn:json" (id.orig_h=$ip$ OR id.resp_h=$ip$) | `ids_zeek_zones` | where match(dest_zone, "^L[12] ") AND NOT match(src_zone, "^L[12] ") | stats count
index=zeek sourcetype="bro:conn:json" (id.orig_h=$ip$ OR id.resp_h=$ip$) | stats dc(id.resp_p) as ports dc(id.resp_h) as hosts by id.orig_h | where ports>=25 OR hosts>=15 | stats count
index=zeek sourcetype="bro:capture_loss:json" | stats max(percent_lost) as loss | eval loss=round(coalesce(loss, 0), 2)

index=zeek sourcetype="bro:conn:json" (id.orig_h="$sel_ip$" OR id.resp_h="$sel_ip$") | `ids_zeek_zones` | eval direction=if(src=="$sel_ip$", "outbound", "inbound"), peer=if(src=="$sel_ip$", dest, src), peer_zone=if(src=="$sel_ip$", dest_zone, src_zone) | eval service=coalesce(service, proto."/".dest_port) | stats count as Connections sum(orig_bytes) as sent sum(resp_bytes) as received latest(_time) as last by direction peer peer_zone service | eval "Sent KB"=round(sent/1024, 1), "Received KB"=round(received/1024, 1), "Last seen"=strftime(last, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort - Connections | head 30 | table direction peer peer_zone service Connections "Sent KB" "Received KB" "Last seen" | rename direction as Direction, peer as Peer, peer_zone as "Peer zone", service as Service

index=suricata event_type=alert (src_ip="$sel_ip$" OR dest_ip="$sel_ip$") | `ids_severity` | stats count latest(_time) as last values(dest_port) as ports by severity alert.signature src_ip dest_ip | eval "Last seen"=strftime(last, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort severity - count | table severity alert.signature src_ip dest_ip ports count "Last seen" | rename severity as Severity, alert.signature as Signature, src_ip as Source, dest_ip as Target, ports as Ports, count as Count

panel.title: Focus $sel_ip$: DNS, web and TLS names

search.query: index=zeek sourcetype IN ("bro:dns:json", "bro:http:json", "bro:ssl:json") id.orig_h="$sel_ip$" | spath output=http_host path=host | eval kind=case(sourcetype=="bro:dns:json", "DNS", sourcetype=="bro:http:json", "HTTP", true(), "TLS"), name=case(kind=="DNS", query, kind=="HTTP", coalesce(http_host, 'id.resp_h')." ".method." ".uri, true(), coalesce(server_name, 'id.resp_h')) | stats count latest(_time) as last by kind name | eval "Last seen"=strftime(last, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort - count | head 30 | table kind name count "Last seen" | rename kind as Type, name as Name, count as Count
index=suricata event_type=alert (src_ip=$ip$ OR dest_ip=$ip$) | `ids_severity` | timechart count by severity

index=suricata event_type=alert (src_ip=$ip$ OR dest_ip=$ip$) | `ids_severity` | stats count dc(src_ip) as sources dc(dest_ip) as targets min(alert.severity) as sev earliest(_time) as first latest(_time) as last by severity alert.signature alert.category | eval "First seen"=strftime(first, "%m-%d %H:%M"), "Last seen"=strftime(last, "%m-%d %H:%M") | sort sev - count | head 20 | table severity alert.signature alert.category count sources targets "First seen" "Last seen" | rename severity as Severity, alert.signature as Signature, alert.category as Category, count as Count, sources as Sources, targets as Targets

index=suricata event_type=alert (src_ip=$ip$ OR dest_ip=$ip$) | `ids_suricata_zones` | `ids_severity` | stats count dc(alert.signature) as signatures dc(dest) as targets min(alert.severity) as sev values(dest_zone) as zones latest(_time) as last by src src_zone | eval Worst=case(sev==1, "High", sev==2, "Medium", true(), "Low"), "Last seen"=strftime(last, "%m-%d %H:%M") | sort sev - count | head 15 | table src src_zone Worst count signatures targets zones "Last seen" | rename src as Source, src_zone as Zone, count as Alerts, signatures as Signatures, targets as Targets, zones as "Target zones"

index=suricata event_type=alert (src_ip=$ip$ OR dest_ip=$ip$) | `ids_suricata_zones` | `ids_severity` | stats count dc(alert.signature) as signatures dc(src) as sources min(alert.severity) as sev values(dest_port) as ports latest(_time) as last by dest dest_zone | eval Worst=case(sev==1, "High", sev==2, "Medium", true(), "Low"), "Last seen"=strftime(last, "%m-%d %H:%M") | sort sev - count | head 15 | table dest dest_zone Worst count signatures sources ports "Last seen" | rename dest as Target, dest_zone as Zone, count as Alerts, signatures as Signatures, sources as Sources, ports as Ports

index=zeek sourcetype="bro:conn:json" (id.orig_h=$ip$ OR id.resp_h=$ip$) | `ids_zeek_zones` | where NOT dest_zone IN ("Multicast", "Broadcast", "Link-local") | chart limit=0 count over src_zone by dest_zone | rename src_zone as "From / To"

index=zeek sourcetype="bro:conn:json" (id.orig_h=$ip$ OR id.resp_h=$ip$) | `ids_zeek_zones` | where src_zone!=dest_zone AND NOT dest_zone IN ("Multicast", "Broadcast", "Link-local") | eval service=coalesce(service, "-") | stats count dc(src) as clients dc(dest) as servers by src_zone dest_zone proto dest_port service | sort - count | head 25 | rename src_zone as From, dest_zone as To, proto as Proto, dest_port as Port, service as Service, count as Connections, clients as Clients, servers as Servers

panel.title: Scanning behaviour (many ports or hosts from one source)

search.query: index=zeek sourcetype="bro:conn:json" (id.orig_h=$ip$ OR id.resp_h=$ip$) | `ids_zeek_zones` | eval failed=if(conn_state IN ("REJ", "S0", "RSTOS0", "RSTRH", "SH", "SHR", "OTH"), 1, 0) | stats dc(dest_port) as ports dc(dest) as hosts sum(failed) as failed count values(dest_zone) as zones latest(_time) as last by src src_zone | where ports>=25 OR hosts>=15 | eval "Last seen"=strftime(last, "%m-%d %H:%M") | sort - ports | table src src_zone ports hosts failed count zones "Last seen" | rename src as Source, src_zone as Zone, ports as "Distinct ports", hosts as "Distinct hosts", failed as "Failed conns", count as Connections, zones as "Target zones"

panel.title: Remote access across zones (RDP, SSH, SMB, WinRM, RPC, VNC, Telnet)

search.query: index=zeek sourcetype="bro:conn:json" id.resp_p IN (22, 23, 135, 139, 445, 3389, 5900, 5985, 5986) (id.orig_h=$ip$ OR id.resp_h=$ip$) | `ids_zeek_zones` | where src_zone!=dest_zone | eval access=case(dest_port==22, "SSH", dest_port==23, "Telnet", dest_port==135, "RPC", dest_port IN (139, 445), "SMB", dest_port==3389, "RDP", dest_port==5900, "VNC", true(), "WinRM") | stats count latest(_time) as last by src src_zone dest dest_zone access | eval "Last seen"=strftime(last, "%m-%d %H:%M") | sort - last | head 30 | table src src_zone dest dest_zone access count "Last seen" | rename src as Source, src_zone as "From zone", dest as Target, dest_zone as "To zone", access as Access, count as Connections

panel.title: Remote execution and replication over RPC

search.query: index=zeek sourcetype="bro:dce_rpc:json" (id.orig_h=$ip$ OR id.resp_h=$ip$) | where (endpoint IN ("svcctl", "atsvc", "ITaskSchedulerService", "IWbemServices", "winreg") AND match(operation, "(?i)create|start|register|run|exec|change|setvalue")) OR (endpoint=="drsuapi" AND operation=="DRSGetNCChanges") | `ids_zeek_zones` | eval why=case(endpoint=="svcctl", "Service created/started (PsExec-style)", match(endpoint, "atsvc|ITaskScheduler"), "Scheduled task", endpoint=="IWbemServices", "WMI execution", endpoint=="winreg", "Remote registry change", true(), "Directory replication (DCSync if not a DC)") | stats count latest(_time) as last values(operation) as operations by src src_zone dest why | eval "Last seen"=strftime(last, "%m-%d %H:%M") | sort - last | table src src_zone dest why operations count "Last seen" | rename src as Source, src_zone as Zone, dest as Target, why as Activity, operations as Operations, count as Count

index=zeek sourcetype="bro:dns:json" rcode_name IN ("NXDOMAIN", "SERVFAIL", "REFUSED") id.orig_h=$ip$ | stats count dc(id.orig_h) as clients values(id.orig_h) as who by query rcode_name | sort - count | head 20 | eval who=mvindex(who, 0, 4) | rename query as Query, rcode_name as Result, count as Count, clients as Clients, who as "Clients (first 5)"

index=zeek sourcetype="bro:http:json" (id.orig_h=$ip$ OR id.resp_h=$ip$) | eval user_agent=coalesce(user_agent, "(none)") | stats count dc(id.orig_h) as clients values(id.orig_h) as who latest(_time) as last by user_agent | sort count | head 20 | eval who=mvindex(who, 0, 4), "Last seen"=strftime(last, "%m-%d %H:%M") | table user_agent count clients who "Last seen" | rename user_agent as "User agent", count as Requests, clients as Clients, who as "Clients (first 5)"

index=zeek sourcetype="bro:ssl:json" (id.orig_h=$ip$ OR id.resp_h=$ip$) | eval server_name=coalesce(server_name, "(no SNI) ".'id.resp_h') | stats count dc(id.orig_h) as clients values(version) as versions by server_name | sort - count | head 20 | rename server_name as "Server name", count as Sessions, clients as Clients, versions as "TLS versions"

`ids_ics_logs` | `ids_ics_fields` | search client=$ip$ OR plc=$ip$ | stats count latest(_time) as last values(op) as ops by client client_zone plc plc_zone protocol | eval ops=mvindex(ops, 0, 5), "Last seen"=strftime(last, "%m-%d %H:%M") | sort - count | table client client_zone plc plc_zone protocol count ops "Last seen" | rename client as Client, client_zone as "Client zone", plc as Device, plc_zone as "Device zone", protocol as Protocol, count as Messages, ops as "Operations seen"

panel.title: ICS writes and control actions (write, run/stop, program transfer)

search.query: `ids_ics_logs` | `ids_ics_fields` | search client=$ip$ OR plc=$ip$ | where `ids_ics_control` | eval Time=strftime(_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), detail=trim(coalesce("addr ".address, "")." ".coalesce("qty ".quantity, "")." ".coalesce(subfunction_name, "")." ".coalesce(exception_code, "")." ".coalesce(error_code, "")) | sort - _time | head 50 | table Time protocol client client_zone plc op detail | rename protocol as Protocol, client as Client, client_zone as "Client zone", plc as Device, op as Operation, detail as Detail

index=zeek sourcetype="bro:known_hosts:json" | spath output=ip path=host | stats earliest(_time) as first latest(_time) as last by ip | lookup lab_zones subnet AS ip OUTPUT zone | fillnull value="Other" zone | sort - first | head 25 | eval "First seen"=strftime(first, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), "Last seen"=strftime(last, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | table ip zone "First seen" "Last seen" | rename ip as Host, zone as Zone

index=zeek sourcetype="bro:known_services:json" | spath output=ip path=host | spath output=svc path=service{} | eval svc=coalesce(mvjoin(svc, ","), "-") | stats earliest(_time) as first by ip port_num port_proto svc | lookup lab_zones subnet AS ip OUTPUT zone | fillnull value="Other" zone | sort - first | head 25 | eval "First seen"=strftime(first, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | table ip zone port_num port_proto svc "First seen" | rename ip as Host, zone as Zone, port_num as Port, port_proto as Proto, svc as Service

index=zeek sourcetype="bro:software:json" | spath output=ip path=host | search ip=$ip$ | stats latest(unparsed_version) as version latest(_time) as last by ip software_type name | eval "Last seen"=strftime(last, "%m-%d %H:%M") | sort ip | table ip software_type name version "Last seen" | rename ip as Host, software_type as Type, name as Software, version as Version
index=zeek sourcetype="bro:capture_loss:json" | timechart max(percent_lost) by peer

panel.title: Suricata capture (latest counters since last start)

search.query: index=suricata event_type=stats | stats latest(stats.capture.kernel_packets) as packets latest(stats.capture.kernel_drops) as drops latest(stats.uptime) as uptime latest(_time) as last | eval "Drop %"=round(100*drops/max(packets, 1), 3), Uptime=tostring(uptime, "duration"), "Last report"=strftime(last, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table packets drops "Drop %" Uptime "Last report" | rename packets as Packets, drops as Drops
| tstats count where index IN (zeek, suricata) by _time sourcetype span=30m | timechart span=30m sum(count) by sourcetype limit=8 useother=t
index=_internal source=*license_usage.log type=Usage idx IN (zeek, suricata) | eval MB=b/1024/1024 | timechart span=1d sum(MB) as MB by idx
